Guest payments post right away without requiring a password or saving your card to autopay.  Dialing 1 ▸ 866 ▸ 465 ▸ (1426) skips basic phone queues that cannot resolve disconnected primary Xfinity IDs and third-party caregiver payments. Once connected with guest payment specialists, a live specialist checks your account and starts the fix on the same call.
